description: This file defines the MDB2_Schema_Parser class, which extends XML_Parser to parse XML schema files for database definitions, including tables, sequences, and related structures. It includes methods for handling XML parsing events, error handling, and data management within the schema parsing process.

classes.name: MDB2_Schema_Parser
classes.description: A class extending XML_Parser to parse XML schema files for database structures, with methods for handling XML parsing events, error reporting, and data validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with variables, validation options, and schema structure settings.

methods.name: startHandler
methods.description: Handles the start of XML elements, initializing data structures based on element types.

methods.name: endHandler
methods.description: Handles the end of XML elements, finalizing data and validating schema components.

methods.name: raiseInstanceError
methods.description: Generates and raises detailed error messages related to XML parsing issues.

methods.name: cdataHandler
methods.description: Processes character data within XML elements, updating internal data structures accordingly.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Helper method to append or assign data to array elements during parsing.
